name: Orochi
source:
Hobby: Bathing

He possesses hair that looks like snake's tongue and an outstanding appearance which is said to be bewitching to any females. However, he has a really small capacity for liquor; even a sip can put him to sleep.

[From [url=https://akasekaeng.ppgame.com/ten.html]English official site[/url]]
